required_behavior.image_input: Telegram should download image/photo input, route it to vision, and describe/help act on it.
required_behavior.web_search: Telegram should route search/weather/time/news/traffic to Runtime Fabric or configured web tools.
required_behavior.image_generation: Telegram should call SDXL image service and return the generated image, not only a receipt.
required_behavior.honesty: Do not claim a lane is ready unless health check passes.
required_behavior.voice_reply: Telegram should generate/send playable voice audio when voice service is healthy.
required_behavior.research_mode: Continuous research must be lightweight, scheduled, receipt-backed, and not overwhelm the machine.
required_behavior.text_reply: Telegram must send a written answer.
